details:
- Rebase onto the vendor's 2.72.0-16.el9_8.8 sources
- CVE-2026-102556: heap buffer overflow from WebSocket Pong signal type
  confusion
- CVE-2026-102557: heap buffer overflow during WebSocket message reassembly
- CVE-2026-102558: heap buffer overflow during WebSocket receive-buffer growth
- CVE-2026-102559: heap buffer overflow during WebSocket client-frame masking
- CVE-2026-102560: heap buffer overflow during outgoing permessage-deflate
  buffer growth
- All TuxCare ELS patches are retained unchanged: chunked and Content-Length
  framing in soup-body-input-stream.c, soup-headers.c and soup-message-io.c;
  header and Range parsing in soup-headers.c and soup-message-headers.c;
  soup_filter_input_stream_read_until(); cookie and date formatting in
  soup-cookie.c and soup-date.c; URI host and HTTP method validation in
  soup-uri.c, soup-message.c and soup-message-server-io.c;
  Proxy-Authorization handling in soup-auth-manager.c and soup-session.c;
  digest nonce replay in soup-auth-domain-digest.c; and sniff_unknown() in
  soup-content-sniffer.c
